newsitem.title: USA: Viking group cuts stake in Cliffs Drilling.
newsitem.headline: Viking group cuts stake in Cliffs Drilling.

text.p: A group led by Viking Supply Ships A.S. said Thursday it cuts its stake in Cliffs Drilling Co to 608,528 common shares or 8.2 percent from 15.6 percent held in June.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include sales of 545,000 common shares sold between October 3 and October 8 at prices ranging from $35 to $36 per share.
The Norwegian group said it owns the share as a short-term investment pending its decision whether to sell some or all of its remaining stock in the company.
The Norwegian company owns and operates supply ships for the offshore oil and gas exploration industry.
